Arcane Propulsion Armor|TCE: Your walking speed rises by 5 feet and the armor can't be removed against your will. Its gauntlets are magic melee weapons you're proficient with, usable only on an empty hand. Each deals 1d8 force damage, has the thrown property (range 20/60 feet), and flies back to you after a throw. Missing limbs are replaced by identical working armor limbs.
Archery|PHB: Your attack rolls with ranged weapons get a +2 bonus.
Armor of Magical Strength|TCE: The armor holds 6 charges. When you make a Strength check or Strength Saving Throw, you can spend 1 charge to add your Intelligence modifier to the roll. When you would be knocked Prone, you can spend 1 charge as a Reaction to avoid it. It regains 1d6 spent charges each dawn.
Aspect of the Moon|XGE: You never need sleep and nothing can force you to sleep. You can gain the benefits of a Long Rest by spending all 8 hours on light activity, such as reading your Book of Shadows or keeping watch.
Banishing Arrow|XGE: The target must succeed on a Charisma Saving Throw or be sent to a harmless place in the Feywild. While there, its Speed is 0 and it is Incapacitated. At the end of its next turn, it returns to its previous space, or the nearest free one. From level 18 in this class, a hit also deals 2d6 force damage.
Banishing Shot|AU: The creature you hit takes extra Psychic damage equal to one roll of your Arcane Shot Die and must succeed on a Charisma Saving Throw or be sent to a harmless demiplane. While gone, it has the Incapacitated condition and Speed 0. At the end of its next turn, it returns to its previous space, or the nearest unoccupied one.
Beast Speech|PHB: You can cast Speak with Animals at will, with no spell slot needed.
Beguiling Arrow|XGE: The target takes an extra 2d6 psychic damage and must succeed on a Wisdom Saving Throw or be charmed by an ally of yours within 30 feet of it (your pick) until the start of your next turn. The charm ends early if that ally attacks, damages, or forces a Saving Throw on it. Damage becomes 4d6 at level 18.
Beguiling Influence|PHB: You gain proficiency in the Deception and Persuasion skills.
Beguiling Shot|AU: The target takes extra Psychic damage equal to two rolls of your Arcane Shot Die and must succeed on a Wisdom Saving Throw or be Charmed until your next turn starts. You or an ally within 30 feet of it (your choice) is the charmer. It ends early if the charmer attacks, damages, or forces a Saving Throw on it.
Bewitching Whispers|PHB: You can cast Compulsion once by using a Warlock spell slot. You can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest.
Blessed Warrior|TCE: You learn two Cleric cantrips of your choice. They count as Paladin spells for you and use Charisma as the spellcasting ability. Each time you gain a level in this class, you can swap one of them for a different Cleric cantrip.
Blind Fighting|TCE: You have Blindsight out to 10 feet. Within that range, you can see anything not behind Cover even while Blinded or in darkness, and you can see Invisible creatures unless they successfully hide from you.
Bond of the Talisman|TCE: While another creature wears your talisman, you can use an action to teleport to the nearest unoccupied space next to them, if you share a plane of existence. The wearer can do the same to reach you. Uses equal your Proficiency Bonus, and all are restored after a Long Rest.
Book of Ancient Secrets|PHB: Add two 1st-level ritual spells from any class list to your Book of Shadows. They aren't spells known and are cast only as rituals while you hold it. You can also ritual cast known Warlock ritual spells. Copy in more ritual spells up to half your Warlock level (rounded up) for 2 hours and 50 gp per spell level.
Boots of the Winding Path|TCE: As a Bonus Action, the wearer can teleport up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space they can see, provided they occupied that space earlier during the current turn.
Brace|TCE: When a creature you can see enters your reach with the melee weapon you wield, you can use your Reaction and expend one Superiority Die to make one attack against it with that weapon. On a hit, add the Superiority Die to the damage roll.
Breath of Winter|PHB: You can spend 6 ki points to cast Cone of Cold.
Bursting Arrow|XGE: Right after the arrow hits, the target and every other creature within 10 feet of it take 2d6 force damage. This becomes 4d6 at level 18 in this class.
Bursting Shot|AU: Right after you damage the target, it and each creature in a 10-foot Emanation from it take Force damage equal to two rolls of your Arcane Shot Die.
Celebrated in House|EFA: Favors gain options. A dragonmarked member casts a level 3 or 4 spell tied to the house's mark for free, or a member casts another spell of level 6 or lower at half cost. Or you get a bodyguard of CR up to half your level (round up) for one mission (max 1 week). Stipend becomes 4 GP daily.
Chains of Carceri|PHB: You can cast Hold Monster at will on a Celestial, Fiend, or Elemental, with no spell slot or material components. You can't target the same creature again with this until you finish a Long Rest.
Clench of the North Wind|PHB: You can spend 3 ki points to cast Hold Person.
Cloak of Flies|XGE: As a Bonus Action, gain a 5-foot aura of buzzing flies that Cover blocks. It lasts until you're Incapacitated or dismiss it (Bonus Action). You have Advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks and Disadvantage on other Charisma checks. Creatures starting their turn in it take poison damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 0). Once per Short or Long Rest.
Cloud Rune|TCE: Carrying or wearing an item with this rune gives you Advantage on Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) and Charisma (Deception) checks. When an attack hits you or a creature you can see within 30 feet, use your Reaction to redirect it, same roll, to another creature within 30 feet of you (not the attacker). Once per Short or Long Rest.
Defense|PHB: While you wear armor, you get a +1 bonus to AC.
Dreadful Word|PHB: Once per Long Rest, you can cast confusion by using a Warlock spell slot.
Druidic Warrior|TCE: Pick two cantrips from the Druid spell list. Treat them as Ranger spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability. Each time you gain a Ranger level, you may swap one of them for another Druid cantrip.
Dueling|PHB: Holding a melee weapon in one hand with no other weapon in your other hand grants a +2 bonus to damage rolls made with that weapon.
Eldritch Sight|PHB: You can cast detect magic whenever you like, with no spell slot needed.
Elemental Attunement|PHB: As an action, you shape elemental forces within 30 feet. Choose a harmless sensory effect, light or snuff a small flame instantly, chill or warm up to 1 pound of nonliving matter for 1 hour, or mold a 1-foot cube of earth, fire, water, or mist into a rough shape for 1 minute.
Enfeebling Arrow|XGE: The arrow deals an extra 2d6 necrotic damage, and the target must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw or deal only half damage with weapon attacks until the start of your next turn. The extra damage becomes 4d6 at 18th level.
Enfeebling Shot|AU: Your hit deals extra Necrotic damage equal to two rolls of your Arcane Shot Die. The target must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw or become Poisoned until the end of its next turn. While Poisoned this way, each attack roll it hits with has one Arcane Shot Die roll subtracted from the damage.
Enhanced Arcane Focus|TCE: A creature holding this item gets +1 to spell attack rolls and ignores Cover on its spell attacks. The bonus becomes +2 once you reach 10th level in this class.
Enhanced Defense|TCE: A creature wearing the infused armor or wielding the infused shield gets +1 to Armor Class. The bonus becomes +2 once you reach 10th level in this class.
Enhanced Weapon|TCE: The infused magic weapon gives +1 to attack rolls and damage rolls made with it. The bonus becomes +2 once you reach 10th level in this class.
Eternal Mountain Defense|PHB: Spend 5 ki points to cast stoneskin on yourself.
Eyes of the Rune Keeper|PHB: You are able to read any writing.
Fangs of the Fire Snake|PHB: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can spend 1 ki point to wreathe your fists and feet in flame. Your unarmed strike reach grows by 10 feet for the rest of that turn, and those hits deal fire damage rather than bludgeoning. Spending 1 more ki point on a hit adds 1d10 fire damage.
Far Scribe|TCE: A new page appears in your Book of Shadows where creatures can write their names, up to your proficiency bonus in total. You can cast sending on a named creature with no slot or material components. Replies appear on the page and fade after 1 minute. Touching a name erases it as an action.
Favored in House|EFA: Your house casts a different spell of level 3 or lower for you at half cost, as often as your Renown Score. If your Renown Score falls below the favors requested, a higher-ranking member may send you on a mission. Your house also pays a Modest lifestyle stipend of 1 GP per day.
Fire Rune|TCE: Your proficiency bonus is doubled on tool checks while you carry the rune. When you hit with a weapon, invoke it for 2d6 extra fire damage. The target must succeed on a Strength Saving Throw or be restrained 1 minute, taking 2d6 fire damage each turn and repeating the save at turn end. Once per Short or Long Rest.
Fist of Four Thunders|PHB: Spend 2 ki points to cast thunderwave.
Flames of the Phoenix|PHB: Spend 4 ki points to cast fireball.
Frost Rune|TCE: While you wear or carry an object bearing this rune, you have Advantage on Wisdom (Animal Handling) and Charisma (Intimidation) checks. You can also invoke it as a Bonus Action to gain a +2 bonus for 10 minutes on all ability checks and Saving Throws using Strength or Constitution. You can invoke it once per Short or Long Rest.
Ghostly Gaze|XGE: As an action, you can see through solid objects out to 30 feet for 1 minute, and you have darkvision within that range if you lack it. This requires Concentration, as if for a spell, and objects look like transparent, ghostly images. Once used, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.
Gift of the Ever-Living Ones|XGE: If your familiar is within 100 feet when you regain Hit Points, any dice you roll for that healing count as their maximum result.
Gong of the Summit|PHB: Spend 3 ki points to cast shatter.
Grappling Strike|TCE: After you hit a creature with a melee attack on your turn, you can expend one superiority die and use a Bonus Action to try to grapple it. Add the superiority die to your Strength (Athletics) check.
Grasp of Hadar|XGE: Once per turn, when your eldritch blast hits a creature, you can pull it 10 feet in a straight line toward you.
Grasping Arrow|XGE: The target takes an extra 2d6 poison damage, loses 10 feet of speed, and takes 2d6 slashing damage the first time each turn it moves 1 foot or more without teleporting. A Strength (Athletics) check against your Arcane Shot save DC, using an action, removes the brambles. They last 1 minute. Damage becomes 4d6 at 18th level.
Grasping Shot|AU: The target takes extra Slashing damage equal to one Arcane Shot Die roll and must succeed on a Strength Saving Throw or be Restrained for 1 minute or until you use this option again. It or a creature within reach can use an action for a Strength (Athletics) check against your Arcane Shot save DC to free it.
Great Weapon Fighting|PHB: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for a melee weapon attack made with two hands, you can reroll that die and must keep the new result. The weapon needs the two-handed or versatile property.
Helm of Awareness|TCE: The wearer of the infused helmet rolls Initiative with Advantage. As long as the wearer is not Incapacitated, nothing can Surprise them.
Hill Rune|TCE: While you wear or carry an item with this rune, you have Advantage on Saving Throws against the Poisoned condition and Resistance to Poison damage. As a Bonus Action you can invoke it for Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage for 1 minute. Finish a Short or Long Rest to invoke it again.
Homunculus Servant|TCE: You magically create a Homunculus Servant using your infused item as its heart, and you choose how it looks. It is friendly, obeys you, and uses your Proficiency Bonus. It acts right after you and only Dodges unless you spend a Bonus Action to command another action. The mending spell restores 2d6 Hit Points to it.
Improved Pact Weapon|XGE: Any weapon you conjure with Pact of the Blade works as a Spellcasting Focus for your Warlock spells. It gets a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls unless it is a magic weapon with a bonus already. It may also be a shortbow, longbow, light crossbow, or heavy crossbow.
Interception|TCE: When a creature you can see hits another target within 5 feet of you, you can use your Reaction to cut the damage by 1d10 plus your Proficiency Bonus, to a minimum of 0. You need to be holding a shield or a simple or martial weapon.
Lance of Lethargy|XGE: Once per turn, when your eldritch blast hits a creature, you can lower that creature's Speed by 10 feet until the end of your next turn.
Maddening Hex|XGE: As a Bonus Action, you send a psychic jolt at a target cursed by your hex spell or a Warlock feature like Hexblade's Curse or Sign of Ill Omen. The target and each creature you choose within 5 feet of it take Psychic damage equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1). You must see the target, within 30 feet.
Mind Sharpener|TCE: The infused item has 4 charges. When the wearer fails a Constitution Saving Throw to keep Concentration on a spell, they can use a Reaction and spend 1 charge to succeed instead. It regains 1d4 spent charges at dawn each day.
Minions of Chaos|PHB: You can cast conjure elemental once by using a Warlock spell slot. You must finish a Long Rest before doing so again.
Mire the Mind|PHB: You can cast slow once by using a Warlock spell slot. You must finish a Long Rest before doing so again.
Mist Stance|PHB: You can spend 4 Ki Points to cast gaseous form on yourself.
Pact of the Talisman|TCE: Your patron gives you a talisman amulet. When the wearer fails an ability check, they can add 1d4 to it, a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, regained after a Long Rest. A lost talisman is replaced by a 1-hour ceremony in a Short or Long Rest, destroying the old one. It turns to ash when you die.
Piercing Arrow|XGE: Instead of making an attack roll, your arrow shoots in a line 1 foot wide and 30 feet long, passing through objects and ignoring cover. Each creature in the line makes a Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failure it takes the normal hit damage plus 1d6 Piercing damage (2d6 at level 18), and on a success it takes half.
Piercing Shot|AU: Instead of making an attack roll, your ammunition shoots from you in a Line 30 feet long and 1 foot wide, ignoring cover. Each creature in it makes a Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failure it takes the normal hit damage plus Piercing damage equal to two rolls of your Arcane Shot Die. On a success it takes half.
Preeminent in House|EFA: When you ask your house for a favor, a dragonmarked member can cast a level 5 spell tied to the house's mark for you free, or a member can cast another spell of level 8 or lower for half the usual cost. Your house stipend also rises to 10 GP per day for an Aristocratic lifestyle.
Protection|PHB: When a creature you can see attacks someone other than you who is within 5 feet of you, you can use your Reaction to give that attack roll Disadvantage. You must be holding a shield.
Protection of the Talisman|TCE: When the wearer of your talisman fails a Saving Throw, they can add 1d4 to the roll, which may turn it into a success. They can do this a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and all uses return after a Long Rest.
Quick Toss|TCE: As a Bonus Action, you spend one Superiority Die to make a ranged attack with a weapon that has the Thrown property, and you can draw that weapon as part of the attack. If it hits, add the Superiority Die to the damage.
Radiant Weapon|TCE: This +1 weapon sheds bright light in 30 feet and dim light 30 feet more (Bonus Action to toggle). It has 4 charges and regains 1d4 at dawn. After being hit, the wielder may use a Reaction and 1 charge to Blind the attacker until its next turn ends, unless it passes a Constitution Save against your spell save DC.
Rebuke of the Talisman|TCE: When an attacker you can see within 30 feet of you hits the wearer of your talisman, you can use your Reaction to deal Psychic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus to it and push it up to 10 feet away from the wearer.
Recognized in House|EFA: When you ask your house for a favor, a dragonmarked member can cast a level 2 spell tied to the house's mark for free, or another member can cast a different spell of level 4 or lower at half cost. On a Bastion turn, you can order your house as a special facility. Your stipend is 2 GP per day.
Relentless Hex|XGE: As a Bonus Action, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see within 5 feet of a target cursed by your hex spell or a Warlock feature like Hexblade's Curse or Sign of Ill Omen. You must be able to see the cursed target.
Repeating Shot|TCE: This magic weapon gives a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls on ranged attacks and ignores the Loading property. If it has no ammunition, it makes one piece of magic ammunition automatically with each ranged attack, and that ammunition vanishes right after it hits or misses.
Replicate Magic Item|TCE: You make a chosen magic item. You can learn this infusion several times, picking an item each time from the Replicable Items tables, where each table's title gives the level needed. You can also pick any common magic item except potions and scrolls. The tables note which items require attunement.
Repulsion Shield|TCE: The wielder gains a +1 bonus to Armor Class. The shield has 4 charges, regained as 1d4 each dawn. After being hit by a melee attack, the wielder can use a Reaction and spend 1 charge to push the attacker up to 15 feet away.
Resistant Armor|TCE: The wearer has Resistance to one damage type that you choose when you infuse the armor: acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, poison, psychic, radiant, or thunder.
Returning Weapon|TCE: This magic weapon gives a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls. After you make a ranged attack with it, it flies back into your hand right away.
Ride the Wind|PHB: Pay 4 ki points to cast fly on yourself.
River of Hungry Flame|PHB: Pay 5 ki points to cast wall of fire.
Rush of the Gale Spirits|PHB: Pay 2 ki points to cast gust of wind.
Sculptor of Flesh|PHB: Cast polymorph once by using a Warlock spell slot. After that, you must finish a Long Rest before casting it this way again.
Seeking Arrow|XGE: Instead of making an attack roll, pick a creature you saw within the last minute. The arrow curves around corners and ignores Cover to reach it, if the target is in range and a path exists. The target makes a Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failure it takes the arrow's damage plus 1d6 Force damage (2d6 at level 18) and you learn where it is. On a success it takes half damage and you learn nothing. If no path exists or the target is out of range, the arrow vanishes.
Seeking Shot|AU: Instead of making an attack roll, pick a creature you saw within the last minute. The ammunition curves around corners and ignores Cover. If the target is within long range, it makes a Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failure it takes the normal damage plus two Arcane Shot Dice of Force damage and you learn its location. On a success it takes half damage. Out of range, the ammunition vanishes.
Shadow Arrow|XGE: The target hit takes an extra 2d6 Psychic damage (4d6 at level 18). It must also succeed on a Wisdom Saving Throw or be unable to see beyond 5 feet until the start of your next turn.
Shadow Shot|AU: The target hit takes extra Psychic damage equal to one Arcane Shot Die. It must also succeed on a Wisdom Saving Throw or have the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn.
Shape the Flowing River|PHB: As an action, spend 1 ki point to affect ice or water in an area up to 30 feet per side, within 120 feet of you. You can turn water to ice or ice to water and reshape ice, such as raising or lowering it, digging a trench, or building a wall or pillar. Changes are limited to half the area's longest side. You cannot trap or harm a creature with this.
Shroud of Shadow|XGE: You can cast invisibility on yourself as often as you like without using a spell slot.
Sign of Ill Omen|PHB: Cast bestow curse once by using a Warlock spell slot. After that, you must finish a Long Rest before casting it this way again.
Spell-Refueling Ring|TCE: The wearer can use an action to regain one expended spell slot of 3rd level or lower. After one use, the ring does nothing more until the next dawn.
Stone Rune|TCE: While you carry or wear the inscribed item, you have Advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks and Darkvision to 120 feet. When a creature you can see ends its turn within 30 feet, you can use your Reaction to force a Wisdom Saving Throw. On a failure it is Charmed for 1 minute, with Speed 0 and the Incapacitated condition, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. Once used, you need a Short or Long Rest to use it again.
Storm Rune|TCE: While you carry or wear the inscribed item, you have Advantage on Intelligence (Arcana) checks and cannot be surprised unless Incapacitated. As a Bonus Action, you can enter a prophetic state for 1 minute or until Incapacitated. During it, when you or a creature you see within 60 feet makes an attack roll, Saving Throw, or ability check, you can use your Reaction to give that roll Advantage or Disadvantage. Once used, you need a Short or Long Rest to use it again.
Superior Technique|TCE: You learn one Battle Master maneuver and gain one d6 superiority die, which stacks with any dice you already have. You regain expended superiority dice after a Short or Long Rest. Maneuver Saving Throw DCs equal 8 plus your Proficiency Bonus plus your Strength or Dexterity modifier, your choice.
Sweeping Cinder Strike|PHB: Pay 2 ki points to cast burning hands.
Thief of Five Fates|PHB: Cast bane once by using a Warlock spell slot. After that, you must finish a Long Rest before casting it this way again.
Thrown Weapon Fighting|TCE: You can draw a Thrown weapon as part of the attack made with it. A ranged attack with a thrown weapon that hits gets +2 to its damage roll.
Tomb of Levistus|XGE: When you take damage, you can use your Reaction to encase yourself in ice until the end of your next turn. You gain 10 Temporary Hit Points per Warlock level, which absorb as much of that damage as possible. Right after, you gain Vulnerability to Fire damage, your Speed becomes 0, and you are Incapacitated until the ice melts. Then these effects end, including leftover Temporary Hit Points. Once used, you need a Short or Long Rest to use it again.
Trickster's Escape|XGE: Cast freedom of movement on yourself once without using a spell slot. You regain this ability after a Long Rest.
Two-Weapon Fighting|PHB: When you fight with two weapons, the damage of your second attack also includes your ability modifier.
Unarmed Fighting|TCE: Your unarmed strikes deal 1d6 plus your Strength modifier in Bludgeoning damage, or a d8 instead of the d6 if you hold no weapons or shield when attacking. At the start of each of your turns, you can deal 1d4 Bludgeoning damage to one creature you have grappled.
Unbroken Air|PHB: As an action, spend 2 ki points to blast a creature within 30 feet with compressed air. It makes a Strength Saving Throw. On a failure it takes 3d10 Bludgeoning damage, plus 1d10 for each extra ki point spent, and you can push it up to 20 feet and knock it Prone. On a success it takes half damage and suffers no push or Prone.
Undying Servitude|TCE: Cast animate dead without using a spell slot. After that, you must finish a Long Rest before casting it this way again.
Voice of the Chain Master|PHB: While you and your familiar share a plane of existence, you can speak telepathically with it and sense through its senses. While doing so, you can also talk through it in your own voice, even if it normally cannot speak.
Water Whip|PHB: As an action, spend 2 ki points to lash a creature you can see within 30 feet with water. It makes a Dexterity Saving Throw. On a failure it takes 3d10 Bludgeoning damage, plus 1d10 for each extra ki point spent, and you can knock it Prone or pull it up to 25 feet toward you. On a success it takes half damage and is neither pulled nor knocked Prone.
Wave of Rolling Earth|PHB: Pay 6 ki points to cast wall of stone.
